summary: Iteration 7 verification of the three new recipe elements (brigade_secret, wine_pairing, impact). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py with 4 pytest tests hitting live POST /api/generate-recipe. All 4 tests PASSED (12.27s) - brigade_secret non-empty string, wine_pairing non-empty string, impact object shape (food_saved_g int, savings_eur float), and impact values > 0. Frontend: seeded a favorite recipe via localStorage 'zsc_favorites' with brigade_secret/wine_pairing/impact={food_saved_g:550, savings_eur:3.5}, opened it from /preferiti and verified all new selectors render correctly with proper formatting and vertical order.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: Impact model wrapped in try/except with fallback Impact() - safe against malformed LLM output. Prompt clearly instructs to base estimates on recovery ingredients only, excluding pantry/shopping.

Frontend RecipeCard: impact-badge conditionally rendered only when food_saved_g>0 OR savings_eur>0 - correct guard. Uses Number(...).toFixed(2) for € formatting. brigade_secret rendered as dark box with contrasting cream text (good contrast).
share.js: buildRecipeText and printRecipe both include brigade_secret, wine_pairing, and impact - PDF export will contain the new fields.
Minor: impact-food renders raw integer without thousands separator (e.g. '~1200 g'). Acceptable for MVP but could format with Intl.NumberFormat('it-IT') for polish.
seed_data_creation: Seeded /preferiti with a single favorite in localStorage 'zsc_favorites' containing brigade_secret, wine_pairing, impact:{food_saved_g:550, savings_eur:3.5}. Cookie consent auto-accepted via localStorage 'zsc_cookie_consent'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file for iteration 7 is at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py (uses helper to read REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env if env var not set - required because pytest process doesn't inherit shell env). Reuse the localStorage seeding approach (see script) to test new RecipeCard fields without paying LLM cost. Verified selectors: impact-badge, impact-food (~<n> g), impact-savings (~<n.nn> €), recipe-brigade-secret (dark ink bg), recipe-wine-pairing (SectionCard). Order verified: impact-badge before chef-touch, brigade-secret after chef-touch, wine-pairing after brigade-secret.
